# Pinned Figure 66 functions

`fishery-impact.R` is an unmodified copy of `R/fishery-impact.R` from
[PacificCommunity/mfclshiny, commit 6df3d40a1621ec3e6cac4646ed77df98cfc32579](https://github.com/PacificCommunity/mfclshiny/blob/6df3d40a1621ec3e6cac4646ed77df98cfc32579/R/fishery-impact.R).
The upstream copyright and license are retained in `LICENSE`.

This copy fixes the calculation and plotting implementation for the report
without requiring credentials for another repository or relying on a later
package version. The build verifies its SHA-256 together with the input files.
The reusable functions are maintained in the upstream package.
